data.description: This belt writhes like a living snake, and even hisses and blinks its red eyes. It clasps by holding its tail in its mouth. The wearer gains a +1 enhancement bonus to natural armor. If the serpentfolk god Ydersius is the wearer's patron, once per day, the wearer can use Magic Fang on one of his own natural weapons.
